title: Thin-slot shield leakage estimate
description: Estimate the worst-orientation field leakage through one electrically small, thin rectangular slot. Engineering estimate, not enclosure compliance.
assumptions: One isolated slot in an otherwise highly conducting shield; L>w and L>=10t define the thin-slot geometry used here.
L<=lambda/20 restricts operation to the manufacturer's electrically small design guideline.
Worst polarization/orientation estimate; no cavity resonance, seams, multiple apertures, penetrations or near-field magnetic shielding.
Estimate only, not a certified shielding effectiveness or EMC compliance result.

references.title: Laird technical note 154, Rule-of-Thumb for Calculating Aperture Size, page 1

constraints.message: The longest dimension must exceed the width; this is a slot, not a round aperture.
Thin-slot estimate requires length at least ten times shield thickness.
Slot length must not exceed wavelength/20 for this screening model.
